posts.description: A major benefit of retirement is being able to be outdoors as much as I want when the weather is nice in November.

If you click the link to the markdown version of my Daynotes page in a web browser you see a benefit of the markdown format over HTML because it is legible when viewed as source. What makes markdown different than HTML is that it is intended be both human and machine readable whereas HTML is intended to only be read by a browser that renders it into something legible.
Two hawks were circling above me today during my afternoon walk.
